{"purpose": "On-time % per weekday September", "sql": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    s.delivery_date,
    CASE strftime('%w', s.delivery_date)
      WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday'
      WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' END as weekday,
    strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) as wnum,
    t.shipment_id,
    t.stop_seq,
    t.site_id,
    t.arrived_at,
    o.window_end,
    time(t.arrived_at) as arr_time
  FROM trip_outcomes t
  JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = t.shipment_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.site_id = t.site_id AND o.delivery_date = s.delivery_date
  WHERE s.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    AND t.arrived_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.shipment_id, t.stop_seq
)
SELECT weekday, wnum,
       COUNT(*) as total_stops,
       SUM(CASE WHEN arr_time <= window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time_stops,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN arr_time <= window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) as on_time_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN arr_time > window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) as late_pct
FROM base
GROUP BY weekday, wnum
ORDER BY on_time_pct ASC, wnum"}
